title: Implement immutable processing-revision eligibility

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Processing revision tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_revision_eligibility.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed the focused PostgreSQL migration/repository probe, mypy, single-head Alembic and diff checks. The verifier observed both accepted codes, non-null eligibility, unsupported and stored-ineligible rejection, DB-enforced immutability, linear migration round-trip and processing-owned shared-MetaData integration without model behavior or foreign writes.
The autopilot scheduler closed TASK-006 after fresh independent functional PASS satisfied all T2 obligations; task-level red-verification is not required.

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-009 RED: processing cannot publish an immutable eligible revision for an accepted pipeline code without loading model behavior; GREEN: a controlled configuration/test path persists the immutable identity with non-null validated_at and repository reads distinguish eligible from ineligible revisions without model loading or foreign writes; decisive comparison: accepted, rejected and immutability observations match the canonical projection; artifact: isolated migration and repository test output.
purpose: Provide the minimum processing-owned revision identity and pre-established eligibility fact required by Photo admission.
success_outcome: The shared schema contains processing-owned immutable pipeline revisions, and callers can resolve only revisions already marked eligible without invoking model behavior.
anti_goals: Do not implement model artifacts, inference, embedding dimensions, revalidation, serving switching or background processing.
Do not create production seed identities or a generic revision-management framework.

forbidden_scope: Serving revision mutation or operator UI
Production model assets and deployment configuration
stop_conditions: The immutable pipeline revision shape or accepted pipeline_code set would need to change.
Eligibility proof requires loading or validating a production model.
The task expands into serving-control or FT-002 outcomes.

constraints: processing owns pipeline revision models and repositories under src/face_moment/processing/.
The migration uses the current linear Alembic head and shared Base/MetaData.
Only opencv_sface and insightface_buffalo_m are accepted pipeline_code values.
invariants: Revision identity and validated_at are immutable eligibility facts in this scope.
No model artifact, inference or processing transition is executed.
Other modules consume eligibility through the processing-owned boundary rather than direct writes.
verification_targets: Isolated migration/repository proof covers accepted codes, required eligibility, immutability and downgrade/re-upgrade against the execution-time linear head.
